title: Essentialism
author: Greg McKeown

lockedEdition.name: Essentialism: The Disciplined Pursuit of Less

rationale: The 2014 Crown Business English edition provides the stable core TOC for Parts I-IV and Chapters 1-20.
The 2020 Crown Currency paperback remains in the same English trade family and does not materially alter the numbered chapter map.
The official 10th-anniversary packaging adds a new introduction and a 21-day challenge, but those are supplemental extras rather than chapter-level structural changes.
No translation was requested and no chapter-order ambiguity was found that would justify a user prompt.
